verdict.rationale: Viam's own materials claim cloud-managed fleet monitoring and alerting. The Fleet Management API manages organizations, locations and machines "the same way you can do in the web UI", and machine status and health are exposed through GetMachineStatus. A Teleop interface can also be used to build a monitoring dashboard. However, the evidence never describes a single fleet-wide dashboard that shows health, location and status across all robots; it consists of short marketing bullets and per-machine docs. missing for 10: documented fleet-wide dashboard view aggregating health/status across machines, evidence of physical location tracking (only organizational 'locations' are shown), independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops lead, I can monitor the health, location, and status of a whole robot fleet from one dashboard
